intro.text: When you read about a day, look for times and actions.

intro.en: he gets up / she goes to work

intro.text: Words like then, after that and in the evening tell you the order.

exercises.explanation: He is a bus driver and has breakfast with his wife. The text does not say how many children he has.

payload.instruction: Read. Is it true, false, or not given?
payload.passage: Kamol is a bus driver in Tashkent. He gets up at 5 o'clock every day. He has breakfast with his wife. Then he goes to work. He starts work at 6. He has lunch at 12 at a small café. He comes home at 4. In the evening he plays with his children and watches TV. He goes to bed at 10.
statements: He has lunch at a café.
